days.title: Meet .NET + Git
learned: What .NET, C#, the SDK and the CLR are
dotnet new / run / build, the .csproj file
Console input and output, int.Parse, integer division
Git: init, add, commit, push, .gitignore

days.title: Data types, var, const, TryParse
learned: int, double, decimal, bool, char, string
Why decimal for money (0.1 + 0.2)
var, const, casting cuts
Parse crashes, TryParse refuses safely

days.title: if / else
learned: Comparison and logical operators
First match wins in an if-else chain
Guard clauses with return
Scope: declare before the block
built: Parking meter v2 (guards, discount, daily cap)

days.title: switch + Git undo
learned: switch statement: case, break, stacked cases
switch expression: =>, or, >= patterns, _
CS0163, CS8510, CS8509 and a runtime crash
Commit messages, amend, restore, revert

days.title: while loops + Random
learned: while loop: check first, zero iterations
Infinite loop from a stray ; (CS0642), Ctrl+C
Random.Shared.Next(min, max): the max is excluded
Sentinel loop and the off-by-one error

days.title: Project 01: Number Guessing Game
learned: Input validation loop: TryParse + nested if
A line above the loop runs once, inside runs every time
Test with a hard-coded secret, test every path
Meaningful names (F2), formatting, an honest README
Git: pathspec errors, git add ., ahead of origin, push

days.title: Git cleanup + the for loop
learned: Git: diff, restore, restore --staged, atomic commits, --amend, push
for loop: initializer, condition, iterator
The body runs before the iterator; N iterations = N + 1 checks
Accumulator: declare before, update inside, print after
Guard clause: ! + early return

days.title: do-while, break and continue
learned: Git: the staging area is a basket (order doesn't matter), clean it before --amend
do-while: post-test loop, runs at least once, ; required
Declare before do so the condition can see it (CS0103)
bool flag: ok = int.TryParse(...), name it honestly
break leaves the loop, continue skips one iteration
built: Day 7 committed in 3 atomic commits + pushed
Times Table v2: ask until valid (3 tests pass)

days.title: Guessing Game v1.1: %, ||, guard clauses
learned: % is the remainder, not percent: 7 % 3 = 1
|| needs one true, && needs both; > excludes the edge
Guard clauses with continue keep the loop body flat
A break gives the loop a second exit: check the exit reason
CS0162: unreachable code after break
built: Project 01 v1.1: range check, guard clauses, q to quit (pushed)

days.title: Calculator v1, arrays and foreach
learned: int ÷ int cuts off decimals; double keeps them
double.TryParse, and double / 0 gives ∞ instead of crashing
switch on a string: exact match, one case runs
Operator guard: != joined with && (|| rejects everything)
Arrays: index 0 to Length - 1, IndexOutOfRangeException
foreach + accumulator + counter, results printed after the loop
built: LinkedIn post 01 (live) + resume Experience + new headline

days.title: List<T> and methods part 1
learned: The last index is Length - 1 (zero-based)
List<T>: Add, Remove, Count, [0], foreach; it can grow
A method is defined once and called many times; each call runs the whole body
void gives nothing back; a return type + return sends a value back
Parameters are filled by arguments in the same order; use the parameter name inside
One method, one job: calculate in one, print in another

days.title: bool methods, method calling method, ref and out
learned: Line 1: the type before the name is the RETURN type; the parameter is the NAME (price)
A bool method: return stops the method; call it straight inside if (...)
else has no condition and no ; (else X; makes the block always run)
Threshold and boundary value: 10 > 10 is false
A method can call another method (PrintVehicle → IsHeavy) to remove repetition
Pass by value (copy) vs ref (original), out + the Try pattern, CS0177

days.title: ref/out quiz and method overloading
learned: The parameter has a TYPE and a NAME: double price
ref = value in AND out (needs a value first); out = the method fills it
TryParse is all-or-nothing: "12a" gives false and 0
Overloading: one name, different parameters (count or types); C# picks by matching the arguments
The return type doesn't count (CS0111); local functions can't be overloaded, so use a static class
Don't reassign a parameter; DRY: one overload calls the other

days.title: Optional/named parameters and Calculator v2 with methods
learned: Optional parameter = a default value in the method header (int days = 2)
Named arguments (days: 5) are matched by name, so the order doesn't matter
Optional parameters go last (CS1737); required ones must be passed (CS7036)
My own Try pattern: false + result = 0 on failure, true + the answer on success
A switch expression needs a _ discard arm to be exhaustive (CS8509)
git restore brings a file back; git add -A stages everything
built: Console Calculator v2: IsValidOperator + TryCalculate methods

days.title: String helpers
learned: Method header (where the default lives) vs call site (where you pass values)
Trim, ToUpper, ToLower; method chaining
Strings are immutable: methods return a new string, so assign it back (name = name.Trim())
Contains returns a bool and is case-sensitive; ToLower first
Replace("-", "") deletes with an empty string; Split(",") returns a string[]
string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace is a static method: True for null, "" or spaces
CS0136: a name can't be reused in the scope around a loop variable
built: String helpers examples (Trim, Contains, Replace, Split, IsNullOrWhiteSpace)

days.title: Nullable, exceptions, DateTime + Project 03 Shipment Tracker
learned: Strings are immutable: name.Trim(); alone does nothing, so assign it back
int? can hold null; null prints as nothing in $"..." (Dart prints null)
?? gives a fallback, ?. skips a call on null, ??= fills only an empty box
?? reads, ??= writes (it changes the variable too)
try / catch: after an exception the rest of try is skipped; catch blocks run top to bottom, specific first (CS0160)
finally always runs; throw new ArgumentException(...) to fail fast instead of returning 0
ex.Message for users, the full ex (with the stack trace) only for developers
DateTime.Now, AddDays (immutable), format strings (MM = month, mm = minutes), due - sent = TimeSpan
IndexOf returns -1 when not found; index 0 is valid (off-by-one)
Git branches (theory): feature/ and fix/ branches, merge into main
built: String helpers exercise (clean a messy customer)
Project 03 Shipment Tracker: add, list, search, mark delivered (93 lines)
